name: smith
description: Autonomous JIRA-driven ticket implementation agent. A long-lived watchdog session coordinates short-lived per-ticket Mr. Smith implementers and Mr. Anderson critics as agent-team teammates. Drives spec→plan→impl with adversarial review, files draft PRs, and self-corrects against PR review comments.

jira_project_key.title: JIRA project key
jira_project_key.description: JIRA project Smith scans for candidate tickets, e.g. APP.

jira_story_points_field.title: JIRA Story Points custom field ID
jira_story_points_field.description: Custom field ID for Story Points in your JIRA Cloud instance (e.g. customfield_10026). Find via `acli jira workitem view <ticket> --json | jq '.fields | keys'`.

jira_sprint_field.title: JIRA Sprint custom field ID
jira_sprint_field.description: Custom field ID for Sprint, e.g. customfield_10020.

jira_eligible_status.title: JIRA status — eligible for pickup
jira_eligible_status.description: Status name Smith looks for when scanning. Tickets must be in this status to be claimed.

jira_claim_status.title: JIRA status — in-progress
jira_claim_status.description: Status Smith transitions tickets TO when claiming them.

polling_minutes.title: JIRA poll interval (minutes)
polling_minutes.description: How often the jira-candidates monitor scans JIRA for new eligible tickets.
